cards.name: Otakemaru the Accuser

effects.lua_implementation: AddSynchroProcedure requires a TYPE_TUNER+TYPE_SPIRIT tuner and one or more non-Tuners.

official_references.matched_structure: T.G. Hyper Librarian supplies standard one-Tuner/one-plus-non-Tuner Synchro procedure structure.
official_references.official_effect_text:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If a monster is Synchro Summoned: Draw 1 card. This card must be face-up on the field to activate [b]and[/b] to resolve this effect.

effects.printed_clause: If Special Summoned: other Spirit monsters cannot return to hand or Extra Deck by card effect during this turn’s End Phase.
effects.lua_implementation: The Special Summon trigger installs End-Phase-only CANNOT_TO_HAND/CANNOT_TO_DECK effects for other face-up Spirit monsters; those destination effects also apply to costs and non-effect movement. Adversarial re-review confirmed this remains non-exact. Adversarial re-review confirmed this remains non-exact.

official_references.matched_structure: Yata-Garasu provides the official End Phase Spirit return being suppressed.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Cannot[/b] be Special Summoned. During the [b]End Phase[/b] of the turn this card was Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: [b]Return[/b] it to the hand. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Skip the [b]Draw Phase[/b] of their next turn.

effects.issue: EFFECT_CANNOT_TO_HAND and EFFECT_CANNOT_TO_DECK are reason-agnostic, so the current Lua also blocks costs and other non-effect movement during the End Phase. EFFECT_SPIRIT_DONOT_RETURN would cover only the built-in Spirit return and not arbitrary card effects. Resolution: remove 'by card effect', narrow the text to built-in Spirit returns, or add effect-only hand/Extra-Deck return prohibitions and use them in c221855414.lua.

effects.printed_clause: Opponent cannot target Spirit monsters you control with effects.
effects.lua_implementation: A field CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET applies aux.tgoval to face-up Spirits.

official_references.matched_structure: Protecting Spirit Loagaeth supplies official effect-target protection structure.
official_references.official_effect_text: If this card on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 monster on the field; it [b]cannot[/b] be destroyed by battle this turn. [b]You can[/b] only use each of the following effects of "Protecting Spirit Loagaeth" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b]. If an effect of a Fairy monster you control is activated (except during the Damage Step): [b]You can[/b] Special Summon this card from your hand. [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 face-up card your opponent controls [b]and[/b] 1 Attack Position monster you control; [b]banish[/b] that opponent's card, [b]and if you do[/b], change your monster to Defense Position.

effects.printed_clause: If a Spirit is Normal Summoned: target an opponent card; return it to hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed field EVENT_SUMMON_SUCCESS trigger accepts either player’s Normal Summoned Spirit, targets one opponent on-field card, and returns it if related.

official_references.matched_structure: Compulsory Evacuation Device supplies official target-and-return operation.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Target[/b] 1 monster on the field; [b]return[/b] that [b]target[/b] to the hand.

effects.printed_clause: End Phase if this was Special Summoned this turn: return it to Extra Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: A forced PHASE_END trigger checks STATUS_SPSUMMON_TURN and sends the related Synchro to LOCATION_EXTRA.

official_references.matched_structure: Shinobaroness Shade Peacock/Spirit Extra Deck monsters use phase-timed return procedures.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]You can[/b] Ritual Summon this card with "Shinobird's Calling". This card's name becomes "Shinobaroness Peacock" while in the hand or on the field. If this card is Ritual Summoned: [b]You can[/b] add 1 Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand that mentions "Spirit monster" in its text. [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Shinobaroness Shade Peacock" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b]. [b]Once[/b] [b]per turn[/b], during the [b]Standby Phase[/b] of the next turn after this card was banished: Special Summon this banished card. [b]Once[/b] [b]per turn[/b], during the [b]End Phase[/b], if this card was Special Summoned this turn: [b]Return[/b] this card to the hand.

effects.printed_clause: If it returned, Special Summon two Spirits from GY, one Tuner and one non-Tuner, total Levels 9, ignoring conditions.
effects.lua_implementation: After successful Extra return, subgroup selection requires exactly two, total level 9, both tuner-role classes, two zones and no Blue-Eyes Spirit lock; SpecialSummon uses nocheck/nolimit true.

official_references.matched_structure: Soul Charge supplies multi-monster GY Special Summon structure; official ignore-condition summons use nocheck=true.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Target[/b] any number of monsters in your GY; Special Summon them, [b]and if you do[/b], you lose 1000 LP for each monster Special Summoned by this effect. You [b]cannot[/b] conduct your [b]Battle Phase[/b] the turn you activate this card. [b]You can[/b] only activate 1 "Soul Charge" [b]per turn[/b].

cards.audit_note: Confirmed an unresolved reason-filtering limitation in destination prohibitions.
